turns.text: Cumulative production (kg) per 반응기 over 일자 — per-run production = 생산속도 × 가동시간 / 1000. One line per reactor, daily resolution.

asks.ask: Cumulative production per reactor over time

spec.data_code:
df['생산량_kg'] = df['생산속도 (g/h)'] * df['가동시간 (h)'] / 1000
df = df.sort_values('일자')
df['누적생산량(kg)'] = df.groupby('반응기')['생산량_kg'].cumsum()

result.hint: names: df (pandas DataFrame of the table), pd, np; leave the result in df
